title: CHAPTER 12 POLICE STRENGTH Tables 58, 59 and 60 present the actual strength of police both civil and Armed in different States, Union Territories and Metropolitan Cities alongwith percentage composition of civil police to total police, the number of policemen per hundred kilometre area, the number of policemen per ten thousand of population and the number of IPC crimes per civil policemen. On an average, civil police constituted 74·0 per cent to total strength of police. This percentage varied from State to State. It was the highest in case of Maharashtra (90·4 per cent) and the lowest in the case of Nagaland (34·0 per cent).
